question: Who won the Best Director and Best Film awards at the 47th Moscow International Film Festival for the film Ha Lyngkha Bneng?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradip Kurbah.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Pradip Kurbah won Best Director and Best Film awards at the 47th Moscow International Film Festival for his film *Ha Lyngkha Bneng*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradip Kurbah is a self-taught filmmaker from Meghalaya.**
 
• **His film *Ha Lyngkha Bneng* won the Best Film award at the festival.**
 
• The awards were presented by the Network for Promotion of Asian Cinema (NETPAC).
 
• Meghalaya Chief Minister Conrad K. Sangma congratulated Kurbah on this achievement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Moscow International Film Festival__

 __
 
• One of the oldest film festivals, founded in 1935.
 
• Recognizes outstanding films and filmmakers from around the world.
 
 
 
• NETPAC__
 __
 
• Network for Promotion of Asian Cinema.
 
• Aims to promote and support Asian films globally.
 
 
 
• Ha Lyngkha Bneng__
 
 
• A film directed by Pradip Kurbah, which showcases the cultural and social life of Meghalaya.
